Package com.google.adk.workflow

Class BaseNode

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.BaseNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Node
Direct Known Subclasses:
BaseAgent, JoinNode, Workflow
@Experimental public abstract class BaseNode extends Object implements Node
Base class for nodes in a workflow graph. It is meant for the framework's own nodes; to write a node, implement Node. Subclasses implement Node.runNode(com.google.adk.agents.Context, java.lang.Object), and the framework turns each emission into an Event.
